title: wg: protocol-06 endpoint /v1 prefix and placeholder expansion unspecified
description: draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06: (1) §5.1 example paths carry /v1 but §5.2ff endpoint text has no prefix; (2) directory placeholders like {targetUser} have no defined expansion/encoding rule (RFC 6570?). Report to the MIMI WG. Our readings: decisions mimid-1wgh.5.37 and mimid-1wgh.5.38.
notes:
Related open issue ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol#52 ('Figure out versioning') does not cover this.

Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED technical: /v1 prefix and placeholder expansion undefined. New issue (#I).

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/158
2026-10-19 #158 labelled question; rohanmahy suggests per-entry path conventions; followup mimid-1wgh.37.82.
